from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from livekit.agents import AgentSession, llm, ToolError
from livekit.agents.voice.run_result import RunResult
import pytest
from livekit.plugins import openai
from agent.agent_manager import AgentManager
from agent.agents.language_selection_agent import LanguageSelectionAgent
from agent.schemas.user_data import UserData
from agent.transfer_manager import TransferManager
from agent.schemas.profile_v1 import Job, Organization, Profile
from agent.services.container import ServiceContainer
from agent.services.interfaces.purplefish_service import Engagement
from tests.typed_mocks import create_mock_job_context


def _llm_model() -> llm.LLM[Any]:
    return openai.LLM(model="gpt-4.1", parallel_tool_calls=False, temperature=0.45)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_language_selection_agent(
    mock_organization: Organization,
    mock_job: Job,
    mock_profile: Profile,
    mock_engagement: Engagement,
    mock_services: ServiceContainer,
) -> None:
    mock_job.callLanguage = "multilingual"
    mock_job.allowedLanguages = ["en", "es-MX"]
    ctx = create_mock_job_context()

    userdata = UserData(
        ctx=ctx,
        services=mock_services,
        organization=mock_organization,
        job=mock_job,
        profile=mock_profile,
        engagement=mock_engagement,
        outbound_call=False,
        agent_manager=AgentManager(
            ctx=ctx, engagement_id=mock_engagement.id, services=mock_services
        ),
        transfer_manager=TransferManager(
            ctx=ctx, engagement=mock_engagement, services=mock_services
        ),
        language="multilingual",
    )

    userdata.agent_manager.agents.append(LanguageSelectionAgent())

    async with (
        _llm_model() as llm,
        AgentSession(llm=llm, userdata=userdata) as sess,
    ):
        assert userdata.agent_manager.current_agent is not None
        await sess.start(userdata.agent_manager.current_agent)
        result: RunResult[Any] = await sess.run(user_input="Hello?")
        msg_assert = result.expect.next_event().is_message(role="assistant")
        await msg_assert.judge(
            llm,
            intent="should greet the user and ask them what language they would like to continue the conversation in",
        )
        result.expect.no_more_events()

        result = await sess.run(user_input="¿Puedes hablar español?")
        result.expect.skip_next_event_if(type="message", role="assistant")
        result.expect.next_event().is_function_call(
            name="continue_in_language",
            arguments={
                "language_code": "es-MX",
            },
        )
        assert userdata.language == "es-MX"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_invalid_language_selection(
    mock_organization: Organization,
    mock_job: Job,
    mock_profile: Profile,
    mock_engagement: Engagement,
    mock_services: ServiceContainer,
) -> None:
    mock_job.callLanguage = "multilingual"
    mock_job.allowedLanguages = ["en", "es-MX"]
    ctx = create_mock_job_context()

    userdata = UserData(
        ctx=ctx,
        services=mock_services,
        organization=mock_organization,
        job=mock_job,
        profile=mock_profile,
        engagement=mock_engagement,
        outbound_call=False,
        agent_manager=AgentManager(
            ctx=ctx, engagement_id=mock_engagement.id, services=mock_services
        ),
        transfer_manager=TransferManager(
            ctx=ctx, engagement=mock_engagement, services=mock_services
        ),
        language="multilingual",
    )

    agent = LanguageSelectionAgent()
    userdata.agent_manager.agents.append(agent)

    async with (
        _llm_model() as llm,
        AgentSession(llm=llm, userdata=userdata) as sess,
    ):
        await sess.start(agent)

        # Test that trying to select a language not in allowed list will error
        # We simulate the agent trying to call the function with an invalid language
        # by directly calling the underlying method
        mock_context = MagicMock()
        mock_context.userdata = userdata

        with pytest.raises(ToolError) as exc_info:
            await agent.continue_in_language("fr", mock_context)

        assert "fr is not in the allowed languages" in str(exc_info.value)
        assert "Must be one of ['en', 'es-MX']" in str(exc_info.value)
